This article examines the distribution of [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] scores among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients who have experienced an [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five administrative regions. The data highlights the thromboembolic risk profiles of patients who suffered severe bleeding events, demonstrating that the majority of these patients had low to moderate risk scores prior to their hemorrhage.

Nationally, a CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1 is the leading category, accounting for 261 patients or 36.7% of the total cohort, followed closely by a score of 2, which represents 237 patients (33.3%) [^src1]. Together, scores of 1 and 2 encompass 70% of all prevalent atrial fibrillation patients with intracranial hemorrhage in Denmark [^src1]. Conversely, a score of 5 is the absolute trailer nationally, recorded in only 4 patients (0.6%) [^src1]. 

When analyzing the regional breakdowns, a distinct geographical outlier emerges. While a score of 1 is the most frequent classification in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (100 patients, 40.7%), [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (51 patients, 39.5%), and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (28 patients, 38.4%), the distribution shifts in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src1]. In these two regions, a score of 2 surpasses a score of 1 as the leader; in Region Sjælland, 34 patients (33.0%) had a score of 2 compared to 31 (30.1%) with a score of 1, and in Region Syddanmark, 57 patients (35.6%) had a score of 2 compared to 51 (31.9%) with a score of 1 [^src1]. 

Across all regions, a score of 5 remains the lowest measure, with zero cases reported in Region Sjælland, Region Midtjylland, and Region Nordjylland [^src1]. The data underscores that severe bleeding complications are not exclusively confined to patients with the highest thromboembolic risk scores, as the bulk of the affected population falls into the lower-to-moderate risk categories [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen viser, at de fleste prævalente atrieflimren-patienter med intrakraniel blødning har en CHA2DS2-VASc-score på 1 eller 2 (70 % tilsammen), hvilket indikerer, at selv patienter med moderat tromboembolisk risiko er udsat for alvorlig blødning.
